description: Qwen3.6-27B multimodal base snapshot, as published to B2. 1,199 tensors = 851 text + 333 model.visual.* + 15 mtp.*; the merge relayout substitutes the text stack and copies the vision tower, the MTP head and every non-.safetensors wrapper file VERBATIM, which is why a merged dir built from a DIFFERENT snapshot passes every merge guard and serves a different model.
